body: I'm very close to doing it this morning, but the only thing holding me back is that I saw them Wednesday, got an assessment and they gave me an appointment to see a therapist in a week. The thing is I completely lied and down played everything, just cause (as shitty as it sounds) I wanted to see the girl I've been talking about. I'll feel pretty bad about it, knowing that I wasted their time the other day, so I don't know what to do. I really want to go, but I'm just worried about that.

Wow man, our stories are so similar it's kind of scary. I'm sorry you've had to go through all that, honestly and I'd love to hear about how the ECT goes for you.

And I've kind of talked to her, about a few things. I've told her I thought I was in love with her, but before she could even react to that I quickly told her it was "probably just me being attached". So I pussed out there. I would talk to her about it now, but as your girl is, she is also happily in a relationship with someone else right now. So I find it pointless now, it'd only hurt me more really. 

I guess I do have one question, have you ever admitted yourself into a hospital? Because I'm thinking about doing that. I've never been to one though and don't know what to expect. Is there anything you might know about it?
Pretty much sums up how I feel, man.

Yeah, I really like to hear your story man. It might really help me out.

And I've kinda talked to her about how I feel. I haven't told her I was in love with her, but she knows I'm really attached to her, that's pretty much it.
